fix: day_cell takes Option<Rc<dyn Fn()>> and then wraps it in a second closure, but GestureDetector::on_tap already takes impl Fn() + 'static and boxes it itself. Make the parameter generic: on_tap: Option<impl Fn() + 'static>, pass it straight through with GestureDetector::new(cell).on_tap(on_tap).into(), and build the callers without the Rc, e.g. let on_tap = enabled.then(|| { let picker = picker.clone(); move || picker.select(date) }); (the same change applies to the enabled.then in range_month at line 1086-1089 with state.tap(date)).
